findings.title: Whitespace-only query bypasses min-length guard
findings.problem: handleSearch checks query.length < MIN_SEARCH_LENGTH but a whitespace-only string like '  ' (length >= 2) passes the guard and triggers runSearch with a semantically empty query.
findings.impact: Unnecessary API call to the user search endpoint; the server may return all users or error, and the loading spinner fires for an empty input.
findings.recommendation: Replace query.length < MIN_SEARCH_LENGTH with query.trim().length < MIN_SEARCH_LENGTH on the early-return check.

findings.title: BudgetModal integration tests missing for notification_owner_email
findings.problem: No integration tests cover the three BudgetModal-level behaviors added in this diff: (1) pre-population of notification_owner_email when opening the edit modal for a budget that already has an owner set; (2) the empty-string to null mapping in handleFormSubmit; (3) Yup email validation error displayed in the modal form context.
findings.impact: Regressions in edit pre-population, null-clearing on submit, or validation error display will not be caught by CI.
findings.recommendation: Add BudgetModal tests (or extend an existing BudgetModal.test.tsx) covering: open edit modal with budget.notification_owner_email set and confirm field is pre-populated; submit with empty field and confirm onSubmit receives notification_owner_email: null; submit with invalid email and confirm validation error message is shown.
